Running command: cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import struct
data = bytearray()
data += struct.pack('>I', 0x00010000)  # DFont tag
data += struct.pack('>I', 16)  # data offset = 16 (points to data block after header)
data += struct.pack('>I', 16)  # map offset = 16
data += struct.pack('>I', 0)   # dataLen = 0
data += struct.pack('>I', 28)  # mapLen = 28

# ResourceMap (28 bytes) at offset 16
data += b'\x00' * 16  # reserved0
data += struct.pack('>I', 0)  # reserved1
data += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # resreved2
data += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # attrs
data += struct.pack('>H', 28) # typeList offset = 28 (points to type list after map)
data += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # nameList

# Type list at offset 44
data += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # lenM1 = 0 (1 type record)
# Type record (8 bytes)
data += b'sfnt'               # tag
data += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # resCountM1 = 0 (1 resource)
data += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # resourcesZ offset = 0 (null pool!)

# Resource record (12 bytes) - not actually present since resourcesZ=0
# But we need the data block to have an OpenTypeFontFace at data_base+4
# data_base = &(this+data) = this+16 = offset 16 in file
# OpenTypeFontFace at data_base+4 = offset 20 in file
# Let's put a valid OpenTypeFontFace there

# Pad to offset 20
while len(data) < 20:
    data += b'\x00'

# OpenTypeFontFace at offset 20 (data_base+4)
# sfnt_version = 0x00010000
data += struct.pack('>I', 0x00010000)
# tables: BinSearchArrayOf<TableRecord>
# len (2 bytes), searchRange (2), entrySelector (2), rangeShift (2)
data += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # len = 0 (no tables)
data += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # searchRange
data += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # entrySelector
data += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # rangeShift

open('/tmp/dfont_resz0.bin', 'wb').write(data)
print('size:', len(data))
"
/tmp/hb_shape_fuzzer /tmp/dfont_resz0.bin 2>&1 | head -40
